name: personal-rns
description: Correct, robust, fast Personal Reticulum bindings for native JavaScript and browsers.

scripts.build:code: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.casework-cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.qwik.json && vite build --mode lib --config vite.qwik.config.ts && node scripts/stage-code.mjs
scripts.build:native: npm run build:code && node scripts/stage.mjs native
scripts.build:browser: npm run build:code && node scripts/stage.mjs browser
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.casework-cjs.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.qwik.json --noEmit --emitDeclarationOnly false && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json
scripts.test: npm run build:code && node --test tests/async-lanes.test.mjs tests/browser-auto-wifi-reconnect.test.mjs tests/browser-bluetooth.test.mjs tests/browser-command-settlement-batch.test.mjs tests/browser-contract.test.mjs tests/browser-outbound-batch.test.mjs tests/browser-outbound-scheduling.test.mjs tests/browser-packed-snapshot.test.mjs tests/browser-projections.test.mjs tests/browser-protocol-crypto.test.mjs tests/browser-resource-crypto.test.mjs tests/browser-resource-send.test.mjs tests/browser-runtime-boundary.test.mjs tests/browser-websocket-bitrate.test.mjs tests/browser-websocket-decode-batch.test.mjs tests/casework.test.mjs tests/event-projection.test.mjs tests/framework-adapter-contract.test.mjs tests/worker-event-sender.test.mjs tests/worker-projection-sender.test.mjs tests/worker-projection-server.test.mjs tests/worker-wire.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:browser && node tests/browser-smoke.mjs && node tests/framework-adapters.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser:full: npm --prefix ../prns-wasm run build:wasm && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:native:full: npm --prefix ../prns-napi run build:debug && npm run test:native
scripts.bench:browser-full-engine: npm --prefix ../prns-wasm run build:package:wasm && npm run build && node benchmarks/browser-full-engine/run.mjs
scripts.pack:check: npm --prefix ../prns-wasm run build:package:wasm && npm run build && npm pack --dry-run
